description: File registry for PumpSmart M6B dataset generation pipeline. Covers all .pkl, .csv, and .json files produced by M6B Steps 0/0b/1/2/3. Two versions tracked per entry: arch_version (v14.2 = project architecture) and script_version (version of .py script that created the file). locked_after_creation=true means the file must never be overwritten without explicit arch_version bump. Machine-readable: all entries are indexable by filename or path key.

M6B_sequences_groupA_rerun.pkl.semantic_meaning: Group A labels 1,4,5 at physics-correct lengths (250,400,300 steps). CIRA-seeded bearing/seal/overloading sequences with F1/F4 fixes applied.
M6B_sequences_groupA_rerun.pkl.notes: LOCKED — do not regenerate. Created by prerequisite scripts.

M6B_sequences_groupA_carried.pkl.semantic_meaning: Group A labels 0,2,3,6 carried from M6A v5 with F2/F3/F5 fixes. Normal (2000), imbalance (1500), cavitation (1500), sensor_failure (1200).
M6B_sequences_groupA_carried.pkl.notes: LOCKED — do not regenerate. Created by prerequisite scripts.

z_t_sequences_groupA_faults_rerun.pkl.semantic_meaning: z_t latent vectors from frozen M4 LSTM-AE for Group A rerun labels (1,4,5). Each entry: {z_t: (N_windows,64), mae: (N_windows,8)}. N_windows=T//50.
z_t_sequences_groupA_faults_rerun.pkl.notes: LOCKED — do not regenerate. Created by prerequisite scripts.

z_t_sequences_groupA_normal.pkl.semantic_meaning: z_t latent vectors for Group A normal sequences (2000 seqs, label 0). Normal operation baseline for L2 TCN-AE reconstruction training.
z_t_sequences_groupA_normal.pkl.notes: LOCKED — do not regenerate. Created by prerequisite scripts.

z_t_sequences_groupA_faults.pkl.semantic_meaning: z_t latent vectors for Group A carried fault labels (2,3,6). Cavitation dual-sig confirmed: Pres.SV* shift=-0.2304, Pmp.SV* shift=+0.2003.
z_t_sequences_groupA_faults.pkl.notes: LOCKED — do not regenerate. Created by prerequisite scripts.

M6B_sequences_groupB.pkl.semantic_meaning: Group B compound chain sequences. 6 labels (7-12), 1500 seqs each = 9000 total. Each sequence: two faults active with physics-verified lag (50–600s). Phase 1: primary fault only. Phase 2: primary+secondary superimposed. Compound chain: bearing+OL, cav+seal, imbal+bearing, seal+cav, OL+bearing, imbal+cav.
M6B_sequences_groupB.pkl.content_shape: dict{sequences: list[ndarray(T,8)], metadata: list[dict]} | 9000 seqs | T per label: {7:600,8:550,9:700,10:900,11:800,12:450}

z_t_sequences_groupB.pkl.semantic_meaning: z_t latent vectors from frozen M4 LSTM-AE for all 9000 Group B sequences. Captures score_A per window + z_t bottleneck representation. Compound chains show characteristic z_t transition at secondary onset (score_C source). G9 gate: weighted MAE > 0.110058 in ≥90% sequences.
z_t_sequences_groupB.pkl.content_shape: list[dict{z_t: ndarray(N_w,64), mae: ndarray(N_w,8)}] | 9000 entries | N_w up to 18 (900 steps / 50)

M6B_sequences_groupC.pkl.semantic_meaning: Group C masked fault sequences. 5 labels (13-17), 1200 seqs each = 6000 total. Each: base fault (bearing/cav/seal/OL/imbal) with one primary channel degraded (flatline, positive drift, or stuck). Sensor failure precedes full fault onset. Key: label 15 Pres.SV drifts UP (sensor bias) while seal failure causes NEGATIVE Pres.SV drift — M8 must disambiguate by sign + cross-channel. G10: non-masked channels ≥50% of MAE.
M6B_sequences_groupC.pkl.content_shape: dict{sequences: list[ndarray(T,8)], metadata: list[dict]} | 6000 seqs | T: {13:300,14:210,15:500,16:350,17:250}

z_t_sequences_groupC.pkl.semantic_meaning: z_t latent vectors for Group C masked fault sequences. Characteristic: reduced z_t signal on masked channel path, secondary channels carry fault signal. Used to train M8 secondary-path detection. G10 validation: non-masked channel MAE contributions measurable in z_t space.

M6B_sequences_groupD.pkl.semantic_meaning: Group D severity variant sequences. 4 labels (18-21), counts: {18:1200, 19:800, 20:1200, 21:2000}. Label 18 (cav_intermittent): 3-7 burst pattern, NPSHa oscillation. Label 19 (seal_fast): turbulent orifice Q=Cd·A·√(2dP/ρ), Pres.SV collapses ≤20 steps. Label 20 (OL_cyclic): thermal sawtooth with rising baseline drift. Label 21 (bearing_gradual): Paris law low-dK, sev 0.05–0.25, ≥60% seqs below MAE threshold — CUSUM-only detection, PRIMARY LIABILITY CLASS. G11-ext: slope_MotSV > 0 in ≥95% seqs.
M6B_sequences_groupD.pkl.content_shape: dict{sequences: list[ndarray(T,8)], metadata: list[dict]} | 5200 seqs | T: {18:300,19:150,20:600,21:1000}
M6B_sequences_groupD.pkl.notes: Label 21 (2000 seqs, 1000 steps) is largest single class. Sub-threshold % should be ≥60% — check results dict key step2_label21_subthreshold_pct.

z_t_sequences_groupD.pkl.semantic_meaning: z_t latent vectors for Group D sequences. Critical for label 21: z_t drift slope (score_B) is the L3 CUSUM input. Label 21 z_t shows slow monotonic drift in z_t space detectable by TCN-AE with high dilation (d=16), invisible to fixed-threshold L1. Also includes label 21 z_t for sub-threshold % validation.
z_t_sequences_groupD.pkl.content_shape: list[dict{z_t: ndarray(N_w,64), mae: ndarray(N_w,8)}] | 5200 entries | label 21: up to 20 windows each

M6B_sequences_groupE.pkl.semantic_meaning: Group E multi-sensor failure sequences. 2 variants × 800 = 1600 total. E_thermal (label 22): Mot.TV + Temp.SV both fail — shared thermal excitation rail. E_pump (label 23): Pmp.SV + Pmp.PV both fail — moisture ingress to pump-side junction box. G11: exactly 2 channels anomalous; remaining 6 within ±0.20 baseline (≥90% seqs). multi_sensor_anomaly_count=2 in all metadata entries.
M6B_sequences_groupE.pkl.content_shape: dict{sequences: list[ndarray(T,8)], metadata: list[dict]} | 1600 seqs | T=200 both variants

z_t_sequences_groupE.pkl.semantic_meaning: z_t latent vectors for Group E sequences. Characteristic: MAE spike on exactly 2 channel dimensions simultaneously. M8 uses multi_sensor_count=2 flag derived from this z_t pattern. Gate M8-14: Group E TPR ≥ 88% for multi_sensor_count=2 detection.

M6B_combined_sequences.pkl.semantic_meaning: FULL MERGED DATASET — all groups A through E. ~32500 total sequences, 22+2 classes, labels 0–23. Groups: A(10700) + B(9000) + C(6000) + D(5200) + E(1600). Primary input for M8 TCN-AE fault validation pool and adversarial testing. Each sequence is ndarray(T,8) in normalized space (P*, a*, ΔT*). Normalization: cluster-relative (M3 config). Sequences generated in M6B LOCKED channel order: Mot.SV=0, Pmp.SV=1, Mot.TV=2, Pmp.PV=3, Temp.SV=4, Pres.SV=5, Pmp.TV=6, Mot.PV=7.
M6B_combined_sequences.pkl.content_shape: dict{sequences: list[ndarray(T,8)], metadata: list[dict]} | ~31800 seqs | T varies per label
M6B_combined_sequences.pkl.notes: This is the single authoritative dataset file for PumpSmart v14.2. M7 does NOT read this directly — M7 reads M6B_feature_matrix.csv (M6.5r output). M8 reads z_t pkl files, not this file directly for training.

M6B_sequence_meta.csv.semantic_meaning: Metadata table for all ~31800 sequences. One row per sequence. Columns: seq_id, label, fault_name, group, severity, cluster_id, cluster_name, steps, source, arch_version, and group-specific fields (secondary_onset_step/lag for B, masked_channel for C, variant for D/E). Used for stratified train/val/test splits in M7. Used for SHAP analysis grouping in M7. Used for gate validation reporting.

M6B_physics_context_strings.json.semantic_meaning: Static physics knowledge lookup per fault label (0–23). Encodes: probable_condition, expected_sensor_behaviour, risk_if_ignored, recommended_action for each class. Seeds M10 Flask API 7-field output (fields 3, 4, 5, 6). NOT per-sequence — one canonical entry per label. Climate-agnostic (normalized space). Contains accurate physics references: Paris law, Joukowsky, Q_leak orifice, Cp·m thermal mass, ISO 1940, IEC 60034, NPSHa/NPSHr physics.
M6B_physics_context_strings.json.notes: LOCKED after generation. Edit requires arch_version bump and M10 re-test.

fault_rules_v3.json.semantic_meaning: 22+2 class canonical fault universe definition for PumpSmart v14.2. Supersedes fault_rules.json (v1, M5/M6A reference — do not overwrite that). Contains: label_map (int→name), sequence_steps, sequence_counts, compound_lag_ranges, group definitions, validation gates, physics_notes. Used by M7 for label decoding, M8 for sequence configuration, M10 for API response label→display mapping. fault_rules_v3.json = LOCKED after Step 3D — any change requires new arch version.
fault_rules_v3.json.notes: DO NOT overwrite models/fault_rules.json (v1 — M5/M6A reference, archived). This is fault_rules_v3.json — separate file.
